ionR1D5j3gI.clarification: The source presentation’s routine minimum 10-day antibiotic course is not a universal current recommendation. NICE NG250 recommends 3 days for uncomplicated, non-severe community-acquired pneumonia in children aged 3 months to 11 years, with extension if clinically unstable. Treatment must follow the applicable local guideline, age, severity and microbiological findings.
